title: Every finite beta=1 cutoff has a closed nonnegative Wick Hamiltonian on a nonlinear form domain

cutoff_form.potential: U_N(phi)=integral_(T3) (phi_N(x)^2-3C_N)^2 dx is a nonnegative finite-coordinate polynomial in Gaussian Q-space
cutoff_form.multiplication_form: q_U,N[Psi]=integral U_N |Psi|^2 dmu with domain D(U_N^(1/2)) is a dense closed nonnegative quadratic form
cutoff_form.full_domain: D(q_N)=D(H_0^(1/2)) intersection D(U_N^(1/2)) is dense for every finite N
cutoff_form.closed_sum: For g>=0, q_N=q_0+g q_U,N is closed and nonnegative, hence defines a self-adjoint Friedrichs Hamiltonian H_N>=0
cutoff_form.relation_to_k1459: The construction controls every particle sector at fixed cutoff by changing to a nonlinear form domain rather than bounding the quartic by H_0
cutoff_form.continuum_debt: The domains and potentials vary with N, the required scalar shift is order N^4 in free-vacuum expectation, and no Mosco, semigroup or resolvent convergence is proved
cutoff_form.ceiling: No nontrivial beta=1 continuum Hamiltonian, interacting BRST operator, positive physical cohomology or source-owned theory is constructed
